title: kyllinga nervosa subsp. oblonga
intro: Kyllinga nervosa subsp. oblonga, commonly known as Kyllinga, is a type of grassy plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, reducing pain, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Kyllinga nervosa subsp. oblonga include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
